title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 6372 Country: Canada Title: I wanted to ask about something which is hard to ask to any other moulana or mufti....but alhamdulillah darul uloom deoband has given me this oppurtunity to ask such a question from those ullama who i really admire and wish to be like themmm...soo i just wanted to ask how can i control my self in having evil thoughts about woman which leads me to masterbation sometimes...and i want to get rid of this evil thing that i do..so inshaallah may allah grants that aalim jannatul firdaws from whose answer inshaallah my life could change and i could also be a better muslim and be like like those of ullamae deoband...and i request any aalime deen to make sincere duaa for me. Question: assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu wa magfiratuhu. I wanted to ask about something which is hard to ask to any other moulana or mufti....but alhamdulillah darul uloom deoband has given me this oppurtunity to ask such a question from those ullama who i really admire and wish to be like themmm...soo i just wanted to ask how can i control my self in having evil thoughts about woman which leads me to masterbation sometimes...and i want to get rid of this evil thing that i do..so inshaallah may allah grants that aalim jannatul firdaws from whose answer inshaallah my life could change and i could also be a better muslim and be like like those of ullamae deoband...and i request any aalime deen to make sincere duaa for me..jazaakallahu khair..assallamualaikum Answer ID: 6372 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1159/1029=D/1429) We pray to Allah for you that you may get rid of this wicked act. You yourself should pray to Allah for the same and pledge with firm determination not to do this bad act in future. Because of this very act, some previous nations have been punished. It is in the Hadith that some people will be resurrected in the Day of Judgment with their hands pregnant i.e. those who play with their private parts through their hands. You should think of disgust, vice and harm of this evil deed. Whenever, such feelings come to your mind, you should turn away your mind from that and engross yourself in doing some thing else. You should strive hard to keep your eyes, heart and mind free form casting an evil look and having bad thoughts. Before going to bed, you should meditate for awhile, ponder over bad effects of this act, do repentance, seek forgiveness of Allah and pray Him to protect you form it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
